_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::low_mach#4 and a FALSIFICATION. The entry told the reader to keep the stabilisation tau consistent between fluid and scalar transport and to 'use Taylor_Hughes_Zarins_Whiting_Jansen for the fluid tau definition'. Following that literally is impossible: the scatra DEFINITION_TAU enum does not contain Taylor_Hughes_Zarins_Whiting_Jansen. Writing it into SCALAR TRANSPORT DYNAMIC/STABILIZATION on the upstream deck loma_2d_heated_chan_30x100 is rejected with 'Could not match this input' and 4C prints the admissible scatra list (Codina .. Taylor_Hughes_Zarins_wo_dt|Zero), which stops at Taylor_Hughes_Zarins. The same upstream deck ships Whiting_Jansen on the fluid and Taylor_Hughes_Zarins on the scalar, exits 0 and matches all four of its pinned results with no 'stair-stepping' diagnostic of any kind -- so the mixed setting is what the 4C developers regression-test. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: leave the scatra tau definition alone, so nothing tries to match the fluid's. The parse error and the printed enum list vanish, so the fixture must go red.
